title: [main] Hidden breaking change and instability on sales/purchase line insert
summary: Makes the v28 check that blocks inserting sales and purchase lines without an existing header more reliable, since it raised false-positive errors. The suppress switch is renamed, a SetSuppress...ExistsVerification procedure is added, the header is checked with an explicit Get, and temporary lines skip the check.
key_points: Sales Line variable HasSalesHeader renamed to SuppressSalesHeaderExistsVerification to show it is a skip switch
New SetSuppressSalesHeaderExistsVerification() so the switch can be set without SetSalesHeader()/ClearSalesHeader()
VerifySalesHeaderExists() now uses an explicit SalesHeader.Get() instead of GetSalesHeader()
Verification is skipped for temporary lines; OnBeforeGetSalesHeader keeps its HasSalesHeader parameter name
Purchase Line receives the symmetrical changes; tests updated in SCM Orders VI
